checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: 5133 high-confidence groups (£18.8M). Duplicate ratio: 1.5%. Filtered out: 952 batch payments, 20450 CSV overlaps.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 618 suspect instances (£144.6M, 12.2% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 2.5x in UNIVERSAL SERVICES. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH compliance — pre-breach only
checks.detail: 7 suppliers have current breaches, but all payments were made before breaches started. Not violations at time of payment.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=11701.32 on 268058 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 4 (4.2% off expected).

warnings: Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=11701.32). Digit 4 deviates 4.2% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
